Soft pieces

Chicken nuggets

Csirkés nuggets

8 months+ Adjusted 35 min 4 portions

Serve warm nuggets that squash easily. The celeriac means this plate contains celery.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 200 g chicken mince
  • 60 g celeriac (peeled and finely grated)
  • 1 tbsp parsley (or another mild fresh herb)
  • 1 egg (cooked through)
  • 30 g fine breadcrumbs
  • 1 tsp olive oil (for the tray)

Allergens

celeryegggluten

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 190 C.
  2. Mix the chicken, celeriac, parsley, egg, and breadcrumbs, and add no salt.
  3. Shape small flat nuggets on a lightly oiled tray.
  4. Bake until the center is white and soft, about 18 minutes, and do not deep-fry them.
  5. Cool and squash any piece that feels firm.

Adjusted

Typical nuggets are deep-fried until the outside is hard. Celeriac, used here for flavor, is a celery allergen.

Bake minced chicken with grated celeriac, herbs, egg, and breadcrumbs until the inside is soft. Do not deep-fry them, and add no salt.
